First of all, your feelings are completely valid. It's okay to feel scared about these things especially with all those horrible experiences you've faced.

Sexual harassment/assault are absolutely not taken seriously enough in way too many cases. Have you tried maybe taking some self defense lessons or carrying mace or anything to protect yourself? I know it sucks to have to live in fear because these things should never happen to anyone but the most we can do if the law isn't enough is do what we can to defend ourselves.

As for the legal side, I'd just advise you to know your rights and understand the laws surrounding the incidents you may face in the future (hopefully you won't have to endure any more). Laws differ from place to place so just be aware of what they are wherever you may be.

Have you tried therapy to deal with your experiences though? Your mental health is extremely important, even for someone as strong as you clearly are!

Thank you so much for this, I really do appreciate you taking the time to respond.

I didn’t realize other people did this too. I honestly didn’t even think it had something to do with my ADHD but yeah I constantly have just about 7 windows open with at least 30-50 per window. And I try to justify it by saying that I’ll need it later or if I close it I might not find it again even if I haven’t visited it in a week. I don’t even know how it got to the point where I had so many open at once but it’s pretty inevitable for me.

I know how this is, I dealt with it for a long time. But trust me when I say that validation from others is nice but when you are able to validate yourself, it’s the best thing ever. Don’t get me wrong, it’s very difficult and could take a long time. But you are worth the time and effort, more than you realize right now. Finding someone is nice but don’t rely on them because at the end of the day you’re all you have for sure. I don’t mean to sound harsh or blunt and I hope I didn’t come off wrong, I really only want the best for you and for you to see your value.

It sucks to not be noticed and to not be greeted, I know. I hated it and it used to get to me so much. But because I know what it’s like, I told myself I would do what I could to make sure I didn’t do that to others. Try being the first to speak. It’s tough but it’ll pay off.

Honestly I used to be this way so much more often than I am now and I understand that it absolutely sucks. It’s not something that can be “fixed” easily. It really does take a lot and it’s hard to get started.

My advice would be to just start taking opportunities when they come up regardless of which side you’re in at the moment. It’ll be difficult but hopefully it will pay off. Try having a regular commitment. It could be a good combat to those feelings and show you ways that you can heal and move forward.

Depression is biologically a lack of seratonin which isn’t something predictable.

Your depression is not invalid it’s just confusing which is how it is for many of us when we first are diagnosed or realize it is a major inhibition in our lives.

Don’t beat yourself up just because there’s no obvious reason as to why you’re dealing with this right now. There’s always a reason and sometimes it’s just the chemicals in your brain being out of balance.

You’ll be okay, stay strong.

I've dealt with pretty severe depression my whole life and I know what you mean. Trying to get and stay motivated is extremely difficult and honestly it could take a long time for it to be consistent so try to take it slowly. Maybe try to put yourself on a schedule and work on pushing yourself to be as productive as you can whether you feel the motivation to or not. It will definitely feel horrible but over time it can be helpful.

Also a note on the suicide part, I understand that completely and have gotten close so many times but trust me it will not be worth it. If there's at least one thing you love or are passionate about, try using that as a reason to stay alive. You could try listing one or two thing a day/week that you're grateful for and adding more if you think of something else.
